_gemini_flash_note: gemini_flash MUST track whatever the `flash` tier resolves to in agy-delegate.sh's model_for_tier(), because agy-cost-compare.sh picks this key by tier NAME, not by model. Since 0.26.0 that is Gemini 3.8 Flash (High), so gemini_flash mirrors gemini_flash_38. gemini_flash_38's numbers are carried over unchanged from 3.6/3.7 (same promotional structure the vendor has used for every 3.x Flash release) but are UNCONFIRMED for 3.8 specifically: one fetch of ai.google.dev returned these figures, a second fetch of the Vertex pricing page instead denied the model exists at all — a live `agy models` call confirms 3.8 Flash IS available on this plan, so that denial is a stale-knowledge artifact of the fetch tool, not evidence the model is unpriced, but the numbers below were not independently corroborated the way 3.6/3.7 were. Re-verify against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing directly before quoting a cost figure that matters. IMPORTANT: 3.6/3.7/3.8 are on PROMOTIONAL pricing that ends 2026-12-31 — on 2027-01-01 input goes 0.75 -> 1.50, output 3.75 -> 7.50 and cached_in 0.075 -> 0.15. Leaving these as-is after that date understates the Gemini side by half. The _post_2026 entries carry the standard rates; copy them over then. 3.6/3.7 figures verified 2026-08-17 against ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing and Google Cloud's Agent Platform pricing page.
_comment: Per-1M-token USD on Vertex AI, ~2026-07. VERIFY against current Google Cloud / Anthropic pricing before quoting. Global endpoints; regional/multi-region carry a ~10% premium.
_cache_note: cache_write_mult / cache_read_mult apply to the CLAUDE deck only. Gemini prices cached input at a flat rate (cached_in) and bills context-cache STORAGE by time, which agy does not report — so any Gemini-side figure you compute here is a LOWER BOUND.
